android.desc: GPS Camera helps you capture photos and videos with GPS location, timestamp, map, address, date, time, latitude and longitude. Turn every photo or video into a useful location record with customizable GPS stamps. Whether you are traveling, working at a construction site, completing a field visit, documenting property, or simply saving memories, GPS Camera makes it easy to remember exactly where and when your photos and videos were captured. 📍 GPS LOCATION & TIMESTAMP CAMERA Capture photos with accurate GPS location details and timestamp information. Add useful location data directly to your photos, including: • GPS location • Full or short address • Date and time • Latitude and longitude • Map • Altitude • Compass direction • Weather information 🎥 GPS CAMERA FOR PHOTOS & VIDEOS GPS Camera isn't limited to photos. Record videos with location and timestamp details displayed directly on your video. Create location-stamped photos and videos for travel, field work, construction, property inspections, delivery records, outdoor activities and everyday memories. 🗺️ ADD LOCATION TO PHOTOS Use automatic location to quickly detect your current GPS position or choose a location manually when needed. Add a GPS location stamp to your photos with address, coordinates, date, time and map information. Already have photos in your gallery? Add location and timestamp details to existing photos without capturing them again. 🎨 CUSTOM GPS STAMP TEMPLATES Choose from multiple GPS camera templates and customize the information displayed on your photos and videos. Create a stamp that matches your needs by showing the details that matter to you: • Address • GPS coordinates • Date & time • Map • Weather • Altitude • Compass • Custom information Use different layouts and styles for personal photos, travel memories or professional work documentation. 📸 TIMESTAMP CAMERA Add date and time stamps to photos and videos automatically. Choose your preferred date and time format and create clear timestamped records of important moments. Timestamp Camera is useful when you need to document when and where a photo was captured. 📂 ORGANIZE PHOTOS INTO FOLDERS Keep your captured photos organized by saving them into separate folders.
